versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the 人头人体检测 (Head & Person Detection) skill.
- Detects heads and human bodies in input images, returning detection bounding boxes, confidence scores, and labels.
- Requires API key configuration; will prompt the user if missing.
- Supports detection via image URL or base64-encoded image data.
- Includes clear tool selection and parameter extraction workflow.
- Ensures all tool results are clearly presented to the user.
